Please include the following details in your report

## Language
The language being used:

## System
Operating system version:
Screenreader: name, version, language
Braille display (if used): name, version, language
Software or reading app used to open/read the mathematics (e.g. MS Word, etc)

## Barrier
If you experienced any barriers to the mathematics, please specify for each:

Area: speech, braille, navigation
Description with example:
Expected behaviour: 
Severity of the issue: 

   * Critical – prevents access to or understanding of the mathematical content.
   * High – creates significant difficulty or requires assistance.
   * Medium – causes inconvenience or makes access less efficient.
   * Low – minor issue or improvement to usability.
